title: SUSU BOX reaches 48,000 customers across all 16 regions
excerpt: Twelve years after starting in Makola Market, SUSU BOX now protects families and businesses in every region of Ghana.
body:
SUSU BOX has reached a major milestone: more than 48,000 customers are now protected by our health, life, motor and property plans, with agents active in all 16 regions of Ghana.

"When we started with one savings box in Makola, we dreamed of a day when every trader could afford protection," said CEO Akosua Mensah. "Today that dream is coming true, one small contribution at a time."

The growth has been driven by mobile money payments, which let customers pay as little as one cedi a day, and by our network of more than 600 field agents who explain insurance in local languages.

Over the next year, SUSU BOX plans to open three new branches and launch a dedicated plan for farmers.

title: 3,000 market women screened at Makola Health Drive
excerpt: Free health screenings, plus six months of subsidised health cover for traders at Makola Market.
body:
Over three days, SUSU BOX nurses and partner doctors screened more than 3,000 traders at Makola Market for blood pressure, diabetes and eye problems.

Every participant was offered six months of subsidised Health Cover, and more than 1,800 traders enrolled on the spot.

"Many of these women never visit a hospital until it is an emergency," said Efua Owusu, Head of Underwriting. "We want to change that by making care affordable before problems become serious."

title: How to make a claim in three simple steps
excerpt: Our claims team explains exactly what to do, and how we pay most claims within seven days.
body:
Making a claim with SUSU BOX is designed to be simple.

Step 1: Call or WhatsApp us on our claims line, or visit any branch. Have your policy reference number ready.

Step 2: Send us photos of the supporting documents, such as hospital receipts, a police report or photos of the damage.

Step 3: Our claims officer reviews your claim and pays approved claims directly to your mobile money wallet, usually within seven days.

If you need help at any point, our customer care team is available Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm.

title: New Tamale branch opens its doors
excerpt: Customers in the Northern Region can now visit SUSU BOX in person on Central Market Road.
body:
SUSU BOX has officially opened a new branch on Central Market Road in Tamale, our first full branch in the north of Ghana.

The branch offers all SUSU BOX products, claims support and agent training, and is staffed by a team fluent in Dagbani, Hausa and English.

The opening was attended by local chiefs, market leaders and members of the Okada Riders Association.
